overview.Module Title: Marketing and Branding for Cultural and Creative Industries

sections.Aims and Fit of Module: Aims: This module aims to equip students with the knowledge and practical skills to develop expertise in marketing and branding for the cultural and creative industries. Objectives: Students will learn established marketing and branding strategies and apply them in CCI context.
sections.Learning outcomes: A Demonstrate a systematic understanding of the theories and debates of branding for the cultural and creative industries B Evaluate critically the contemporary practices of marketing and branding for the cultural and creative industries C Apply critically the techniques of digital branding and marketing relative to the cultural and creative industries D Communicate effectively to an audience displaying highly advanced communication skills
sections.Method of teaching and learning: This module is taught with lectures delivering content, often related to reading, and seminars where students will hold structured as well as informal discussions and workshops.
